title: CMV-associated Immunomodulation in Renal Transplant Patients
official: CMV-associated Immunomodulation in Renal Transplant Patients
summary: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection has been associated with an increased risk of bacterial, fungal and viral infections in solid organ transplant recipients. The purpose of this study to evaluate if the occurrence of CMV viremia modify the ability to develop optimal immune responses against other pathogens in kidney transplant recipients (heterologous immunity). The objective of this project is to identify the immune pathways affected by CMV in the context of immunosuppression associated with kidney transplantation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. st cohort :

   * Age \> 18 years
   * patients with end-stage renal failure programmed for kidney transplantation with a live donor
2. nd cohort :

   * Age \> 18 years
   * kidney transplant recipient with CMV viremia

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients under guardianship, curatorship, legal protection.

For patients with end-stage renal failure scheduled to receive a kidney transplant from a living donor :

* Patients with an active viral (other than CMV), bacterial or fungal infection at the time of inclusion
* patients receiving a desensitization protocol (ABO or anti-HLA)
